The one confirmed finding this change-set exists to close, F1 (medium) of ART-20260906-026, was fixed by plan ART-20260906-027 step 1 (commit 8ed8d00): clientFilterScopeFor's construction in components/IssueWorkspace.tsx is now gated on can(state.model, actor, 'internal.view').allowed, so a client/guest seat (whose zeroed projectMembers previously forced an always-empty stakeholder set) gets no scope at all and falls back to clientView's own content-based visibility, per lib/tree.ts's documented undefined-scope behaviour. Scenario CD9 (added in the same commit) proves a client-visible issue nested under a real project-tier node stays visible to that client seat while an internal seat's own member-scoped view is unaffected. F1 is closed, not carried forward.

ART-20260906-026's 'coverage' gate condition 3 (AC6, AC9, AC10 had built steps but no scenario) is also closed by plan step 2 (commit 7c5ec4a): CD10 (AC6, persistence across reopen), CD11 (AC9, Clear returns to the stored choice, never unscoped All) and CD12 (AC10, revealIssue widens to scope or refuses with a named reason) all pass against real fixtures and the real reducer, not typed-in expectations.

F2 (low, ART-20260906-026) -- the setClientChoice self-or-admin gate inheriting the pre-existing defaultRoleIds-to-ADMIN fallback -- was recorded as informational and platform-wide, not something this change's scope fixes; it is unchanged by this pass and remains open at the platform level, outside plan ART-20260906-027's two steps.
